name: Dream Vision Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dream Vision Co., Ltd. and its affiliates run online and mail-order retail of clothing, footwear and other goods in Japan and overseas. It focuses on fashion items for women of all ages sold via e-commerce and department stores, and offers bridal jewelry such as engagement and wedding rings. Dating from 1998 with headquarters in Ikeda, Japan, it is a subsidiary of Rizap Group, Inc.
